name: connect
description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — wallet connect plugin for AI agents. The connect skill opens one browser page with two separate choices: Google or email through Privy (an embedded wallet), or a directly connected wallet such as MetaMask or Rabby with no Privy involved. Every deposit or withdrawal then shows a confirmation page with the decoded call (action, amount, vault, receiver) and is signed only after the operator clicks Confirm. Never holds a key and never decides what a transaction contains; that is Earn's job. A companion to the earn plugin: earn calls connect when no account is known, and hands connect its prepared calls to get signed.
